items.event_time_ist: Oct 21, 2026 (announced Wednesday morning, France, CEST); march planned Sat Oct 24
items.title: Oct 24 Paris 'act II' route declared: Bastille to Opera
items.summary: Gilets jaunes coordinator Benjamin Ball announced on France 2 on Wednesday Oct 21 morning that the Oct 17 movement's coordination filed a declaration with the Paris police prefecture for Saturday Oct 24's 'act II' march: a route from Place de la Bastille to Opera. CGT Paris and the Union etudiante say they will join at Bastille from 2 PM; the coordination's map lists ~340 actions nationwide; AFP reports nurses joining too. Caveats: the filing came Wednesday, a day past the legal three-day declaration deadline (due Tuesday midnight), and Bastille and Saint-Lazare (near Opera) sit inside the current Paris curfew/protest-ban perimeter - so prefect Patrice Faure can still reroute or ban it. Nuñez says he will personally pilot Saturday's security operation and warns even declared demos can be banned without service-d'ordre guarantees; Lecornu admitted Tuesday the Oct 17 doctrine was 'too static and not mobile enough'. The Economy Minister said Wednesday on RTL the government will do everything to prevent Saturday's chaos repeating.
